# Third-party binary

The bundled `ctcdecode` 1.0.3 wheel is redistributed under its MIT license.
It targets CPython 3.10 on Linux x86-64 and loads PyTorch libraries through a
relative RPATH (`$ORIGIN/../../torch/lib`).
